thread:
ana: quick heads up — post-launch microlaunch cleanup for the webinar landing. we shipped the page but we still need a short triage: keyword mapping, schema markup, internal links from relevant blog posts, and a redirect sweep for the temp URLs. priority = pages with traffic + funnel entry points.

mike: can you list the top-5 pages to touch?

ana: yea — pulled by session volume this morning: /webinars/mar-2026 (landing), /blog/intro-to-redwood, /docs/getting-started, /pricing, /customers/case-study-x.

katie: for schema i can add Webinar + FAQ + Organization structured data. want the event times in ISO and the registration link in same page. also we should add breadcrumb schema.

sam: keywords — main target: "redwood inference webinar", secondary: "low-latency llm serving", tertiary: "inference cost optimizations". will craft 3 H2s and meta desc variants.

mike: internal links — i can do a small sweep to add contextual links from 10 high-traffic blog posts into the landing. will use the anchor text matrix in the sheet. link? https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1abc... (see tab "microlaunch-link-matrix")

seo-bot: automated crawl ran at 10:12 — found 3 redirects still pointing to the old ephemeral path (/events/2026-mar -> /webinars/mar-2026) and 2 duplicate canonical tags on /blog/intro-to-redwood.

ana: ok let's standardize redirects now. here's the quick redirect map I started:
```
/events/2026-mar -> /webinars/mar-2026  # 301
/webinars/mar-2026?ref=trial -> /webinars/mar-2026  # strip params
/blog/intro?utm_source=campaign -> /blog/intro-to-redwood  # 301
```

katie: will add JSON-LD for webinar + breadcrumbs. sample snippet i'll paste to staging PR.

sam: sample H2s: "What you'll learn", "Why Redwood Inference", "Who should attend". meta desc draft: "Join our webinar to see how Redwood Inference makes LLM inference predictable, low-latency, and affordable — register now."

mike: action owners? ana = redirects + canonical fixes, katie = schema + staging PR, sam = meta + on-page KW, mike = internal linking sweep, seo-bot = re-crawl after changes.

ana: timeline? can we aim for small wins by EOD Fri and full sweep by next Wed?

katie: EOD Fri for JSON-LD PR is fine. i'll tag @eng for deploy. :white_check_mark:

sam: i'll drop copy in the CMS by tomorrow morning.

mike: i'll push link updates in batches, tracking via the sheet. will do highest-impact 5 pages first.

seo-bot: scheduled re-crawl requested for 3055200000. will report back with status and top issues.

ana: perfect. small checklist so we don't forget: 1) redirects 301'd, 2) canonical dedupe, 3) JSON-LD for webinar+faq+breadcrumb, 4) internal link anchors applied, 5) meta + H2s live, 6) re-crawl & verify. I'll follow up in #marketing tomorrow with PR links. thanks all :rocket:
